headline: Is it God's intention for me to be alone, or is someone coming?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You could not see the picture, but your hand found the one with every possibility in view.
Every tool is present and visible on the table.
You asked whether solitude is God's intention or someone is coming. What catches me is how much remains available on this table.
No one has come, and the absence has become a question about God's intention.
Something has hold of the relationship, keeping it apart from the possibilities already here. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs were alike, yet you reached for the one held at one point.
One rope holds one ankle. The rest of him hangs free.
You asked whether the pause has divine meaning or ends in a person. This card makes me look at the one rope.
Still, the relationship is absent, and you are asking what the pause means.
Something reaches the question just where the pause would become connection. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what's behind this…
c: You turned the Fool. The card was hidden, but your hand went to the beginning beneath a full sun.
The road opens under a gold, cloudless sky.
You asked whether the road was assigned to solitude. The open beginning is the part I keep coming back to.
But the road is empty of company, and the future feels caught between a plan and a promise.
I keep coming back to something between the open road and company. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
